scoring_capture.semantics: Visible Mister score/points fields are captured conservatively. Until the first real jornada is observed, do not assume whether a displayed value is jornada, total or another score when points_status is ambiguous.

transfer_identity_resolution.policy: Resolve missing feed player via player_id, exact prior received offer, then unique roster delta; never guess ambiguous candidates.

clause_buyout_capture.policy: Direct manager transfer is a clause buyout only when ownership delta resolves the player and transfer amount matches seller's previous clause within 2 euros of Mister rounding.
